timeline.summary: Cera Sanitaryware Limited will host Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 9, 2026, at 10:30 AM IST, led by Hemal Sadiwala.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹643.82 Cr (+11.4% YoY), net profit ₹77.34 Cr (-9.6% YoY).
HEMAL JANARDAN, CERA SANITARYWARE LIMITED’s representative, announced Q4 FY2026 earnings conference call audio recording on 9th May 2026 via company website.
Cera Sanitaryware reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹644 Cr (+11.4% YoY) and PAT of ₹77 Cr, holding an earnings call on May 9, 2026.
Cera Sanitaryware filed an investor presentation on May 18, 2026, detailing its retail footprint, brand architecture, and operational metrics.
Cera Sanitaryware Limited’s **Hemal Sadiwala** scheduled an **Analyst/Investor Conference** with **ICICI Securities India** on **9th June 2026** in Mumbai.
Cera Sanitaryware Limited’s **Hemal Sadiwala** scheduled Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings conference call for **5 Nov 2026 at 10:30 AM IST** via dial-in.
